author: Ashley Starflare
title: Commissioning fursona ref sheet (paid after sketch)
content: I'm looking to commission an artist for a ref sheet, but first I need a sketch headshot since I need to make sure you can make what I want before I commit to purchasing. I want at least a front+back clothed+unclothed alts. DM with your portfolio and prices. Follow-up: No time wasting. Don't tell me I attracted bots. Don't ask me if this is serious or bot bait. Don't engage with small talk without posting your portfolio and price sheet. Specifically tell me that you are willing to make a sketch headshot to be chosen. Replies are closed; contact via DM. Character design needs to be fixed; proof of ability required before purchase. Contact: DM @AshleyStarflare with portfolio and prices.
